Name: Scoot custom Four Corners farm and tweaks
Author: GreatScoot
Description:
[size=4][b][i]Now compatible with 1.6+!

What?[/i][/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod adds some quality-of-life changes to maps when playing with Four Corners farm, while still trying to feel fair.
[/size]
[size=4][b][i]Why?
[/i][/b][/size][size=3]I made these changes to the maps after getting near Perfection on my first playthrough. I added these cause I am impatient and got sick of having to walk around to get to specific places I go to often. So, I started modifying maps!
[/size]

[size=4][b][i]Quality of Life Features:

[/i][/b][/size][size=3]- Removed walls of Four Corners farm, for more space
[/size][size=3]
- Added shortcut exit on east-side of Four Corners Farm leading to Town. Faster than going by the bus stop.

- Added shortcut exit on southwest side of Four Corners Farm. Leads to Forest, right next to the Woods entrance.

- Northeast corner of Four Corners Farm map has been changed to allow you to use the fenced off space. I use it for my Obelisks and hid some Silos behind them.[/size][size=3]

- Moved FarmCave to behind house. 

- FarmCave now has three warp spots. They lead to
﻿- Sewer (Next to Krobus)
﻿- Railroad (At station)
﻿- Island North (Next to Volcano entrance)[/size]

[size=4][b][i]Warning?![/i][/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod was made during the end of my Perfection playthrough. It is [i]technically[/i] exploitable. You can go to the Island from the very beginning. You're also able to access the entire farm (debris withstanding) instead of being sectioned off by tool upgrades. Be warned!

[b][u]Only use this mod if you're playing with Four Corners farm. The shortcuts have not been added to the other Farm types.[/u][/b]
[/size]
[size=4][b][i]Install:[/i][/b]
[/size][size=3]Drag and drop the mod folder into your Mods folder, load using SMAPI.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. You can remove this mod by deleting it from the Mods folder.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed error loading holiday maps in Town/Forest. Loads properly now.
